specs.label: Output bar ▸ ortho toggle (on)
specs.note: Turns on PyMOL's in-viewport console; the portalled overlay [data-testid=ortho-console] should appear over the viewport.

specs.label: Output bar ▸ ortho toggle (off)
specs.note: Toggling ortho on then off must hide the in-viewport console overlay again.

specs.label: Output bar ▸ follow toggle
specs.note: Toggles ui.followOutput (sticky autoscroll). Only the button's is-on class flips — not body text or the canvas — so this is verified as an error-free handler; the visual state change is not observable through the audit's objective checks.

specs.label: Output bar ▸ Select Font… dropdown
specs.note: Native <select> offering default/Monaco/Consolas/Menlo/monospace; changes the --pm-font-mono var scoped to the dock. A native select's value cannot be driven by the audit DSL (no select-option action), so only the control's presence is asserted.

specs.label: Output bar ▸ A- (font size down)
specs.note: Decreases consoleFontSize by 0.5 (floor 9), applied as inline fontSize on the feedback pane. The size change is neither body text nor canvas, so only the error-free handler is verified.

specs.label: Output bar ▸ A+ (font size up)
specs.note: Increases consoleFontSize by 0.5 (ceil 20). Same observability limit as A-.

specs.label: Output bar ▸ clear
specs.note: Clears the client feedback scrollback and the ortho ring; the bar counter must fall to 'ortho 0/256'.

specs.label: Output bar ▸ splash
specs.note: cmd.splash(0) plus store.setVisible(true)+splash flag: forces the in-viewport console visible over the scene, so the ortho overlay should appear.

specs.label: Command line ▸ Enter submits
specs.note: Enter on a non-empty line runs the command via session.run; 'bg_color red' repaints the viewport, so the canvas must change.

specs.label: Command line ▸ command echoes to output
specs.note: count_atoms on preloaded 1crn should print an ' … atoms' summary line into the feedback pane.

specs.label: Command line ▸ Tab completion
specs.note: Tab is always swallowed (never moves focus) and, when connected, calls cmd._parser.complete. Completion needs PyMOL's parser/keyword table (a bridge grant); the value applied is not observable via body text, so only the handler running without a page error is verified.

specs.label: Command line ▸ ArrowUp recalls history
specs.note: ArrowUp walks history back into the input value. The recalled value lands in the input's value (not body text or canvas), so it is not observable through the objective checks; the handler is verified error-free.

specs.label: Command line ▸ ArrowDown history forward
specs.note: ArrowDown walks history forward. Same input-value observability limit as ArrowUp.

specs.label: Command line ▸ Ctrl+ArrowUp prefix back-search
specs.note: Ctrl+ArrowUp scans history backwards for the first entry sharing the typed prefix. Result lands in the input value; only handler safety is objectively verifiable.

specs.label: Command line ▸ Ctrl+<letter> chord to cmd._ctrl
specs.note: A non-browser-claimed Ctrl chord (e.g. Ctrl+B) is forwarded to cmd._ctrl('B') so set_key bindings fire from the focused prompt. The call is a no-op unless a binding exists; handler must not throw.

specs.label: Command line ▸ Ctrl+Shift+<letter> chord to cmd._ctsh
specs.note: Ctrl+Shift+B is forwarded to cmd._ctsh('B'). Verified error-free.

specs.label: Command line ▸ Alt+<letter> chord to cmd._alt
specs.note: Alt+B (no ctrl) is forwarded to cmd._alt('B'). Verified error-free.

specs.label: Command line ▸ Ctrl+C left to the browser
specs.note: Ctrl+C/X/V/A/R/W/T/N/P/F are intentionally NOT forwarded to cmd._ctrl so the browser keeps copy/paste/etc. Pressing Ctrl+C must not raise an error or hijack the copy.

specs.label: Command line ▸ drop a file (upload + insert path)
specs.note: Dropping an OS file uploads it via the files API and inserts the server path at the cursor. Needs the file service; also the audit DSL cannot synthesise an HTML5 file drop, so this is recorded BLOCKED.

specs.label: Command line ▸ drag-enter text preview
specs.note: dragenter inserts and selects the dragged text at the cursor before drop (dragMove is a deliberate no-op). The HTML5 drag data store is protected during dragenter and the audit DSL has no drag primitive, so the preview cannot be driven deterministically; recorded for completeness.

specs.label: Quick buttons ▸ Reset
specs.note: cmd.reset — restores the default view; the viewport should change.

specs.label: Quick buttons ▸ Zoom
specs.note: cmd.zoom(animate=1.0) — animates the camera to fit; viewport changes.

specs.label: Quick buttons ▸ Orient
specs.note: cmd.orient(animate=1.0) — aligns to principal axes; viewport changes.

specs.label: Quick buttons ▸ Draw/Ray
specs.note: WidgetMenu wrapping render_dialog. If features/render has registered the render_dialog hook it opens the form; otherwise it appends a warning explaining the missing open seam. Either way the DOM must react.

specs.label: Quick buttons ▸ Unpick
specs.note: cmd.unpick — clears the editor pick; command echoes to the console.

specs.label: Quick buttons ▸ Deselect
specs.note: cmd.deselect — drops the active selection; command echoes to the console.

specs.label: Quick buttons ▸ Rock
specs.note: cmd.rock — toggles the rocking animation; command echoes to the console.

specs.label: Quick buttons ▸ Get View
specs.note: Runs get_view 2, quiet=0, then copies get_view(3) to the clipboard, appending a confirmation or (headless) a clipboard-warning line. Either outcome adds feedback text.

specs.label: Quick buttons ▸ |< (rewind)
specs.note: cmd.rewind — movie transport to frame 1; command echoes to the console.

specs.label: Quick buttons ▸ < (backward)
specs.note: cmd.backward — step one movie frame back; command echoes to the console.

specs.label: Quick buttons ▸ Stop (mstop)
specs.note: cmd.mstop — stop movie playback; command echoes to the console.

specs.label: Quick buttons ▸ Play (mplay)
specs.note: cmd.mplay — start movie playback; command echoes to the console.

specs.label: Quick buttons ▸ > (forward)
specs.note: cmd.forward — step one movie frame forward; command echoes to the console.

specs.label: Quick buttons ▸ >| (ending)
specs.note: cmd.ending — jump to the last movie frame; command echoes to the console.

specs.label: Quick buttons ▸ MClear
specs.note: cmd.mclear — clear the movie cache; command echoes to the console.

specs.label: Quick buttons ▸ Builder
specs.note: Lazily imports features/builder and opens the builder dock via openPanel; the DOM should change as the panel mounts.

specs.label: Quick buttons ▸ Properties
specs.note: Lazily imports features/dialogs and opens the properties dialog via openPanel; the DOM should change as the dialog mounts.

specs.label: Quick buttons ▸ Rebuild
specs.note: cmd.rebuild — regenerate all geometry; command echoes and the scene re-renders.

specs.label: Quick buttons ▸ Abort (progress row)
specs.note: The progress bar + red Abort button render only while cmd.get_progress() >= 0, which is driven by the bridge's 10 Hz status thread. In local mode progress stays -1, so the row never mounts; requires a bridge to exercise. Abort calls cmd.interrupt (asynchronous, lock-free).

specs.label: Viewport busy overlay (OrthoBusyDraw)
specs.note: The in-viewport 240x60 busy box [data-testid=ortho-busy] shows only while cmd.get_progress() >= 0 and show_progress != 0. Progress is pushed by the bridge status thread; unreachable in local mode.

specs.label: Output pane ▸ click focuses the command line
specs.note: The focus proxy: clicking the output pane with no text selected focuses input#command_line. Focus is not one of the objective checks, so only handler safety is verified.

specs.label: Output pane ▸ show N earlier lines
specs.note: The windowing affordance .feedback__more-btn lifts the 1200-line render window. It only appears once more than 1200 feedback lines exist; that volume is not reachable deterministically in the audit, so this is recorded for completeness.

specs.label: In-viewport console ▸ type a printable char
specs.note: A printable key maps to insertChar on the ortho input line. Whether the char is drawn depends on the ortho text/internal_feedback/overlay settings polled from the engine; the handler running without a page error is what is objectively verified.

specs.label: In-viewport console ▸ Backspace
specs.note: Backspace maps to the backspace edit on the ortho line (OrthoKey case 8). Verified error-free.

specs.label: In-viewport console ▸ Enter submits the line
specs.note: Enter with text runs the line through session.run (OrthoParseCurrentLine). Verified error-free; line contents are the local engine's echo.

specs.label: In-viewport console ▸ Escape toggles text/overlay
specs.note: Escape dismisses the splash, else toggles the text setting (Shift+Esc toggles overlay), else _quit in presentation mode. Here it flips text via cmd.set. Verified error-free.

specs.label: In-viewport console ▸ Up/Down history
specs.note: ArrowUp/ArrowDown recall ortho command history (grabbed unconditionally). Verified error-free.

specs.label: In-viewport console ▸ Ctrl+A / Ctrl+E cursor
specs.note: With text grabbed, Ctrl+A is home and Ctrl+E is end of the ortho line; otherwise they fall through to cmd._ctrl chords. Verified error-free.

specs.label: In-viewport console ▸ Ctrl+K truncate
specs.note: Ctrl+K truncates the ortho line at the cursor when text is grabbed, else forwards cmd._ctrl('K'). Verified error-free.

specs.label: In-viewport console ▸ Delete / Ctrl+D
specs.note: Delete removes the char under the cursor, or maps to the Ctrl+D chord / completion-print on an empty or hidden line. Verified error-free.

specs.label: In-viewport console ▸ Tab completion
specs.note: Tab maps to complete (cmd._parser.complete) on the ortho line. Completion needs PyMOL's parser; only handler safety is objectively verified.

specs.label: In-viewport console ▸ Ctrl+V paste
specs.note: Ctrl+V with text on the line keeps its default action so the browser paste event inserts the clipboard text; the keydown deliberately does not preventDefault. Verified error-free (no clipboard content is injected by the driver).

specs.label: In-viewport console ▸ Space (movie toggle on empty line)
specs.note: Space on an empty, ungrabbed line runs mtoggle (or 'scene , next' in presentation, 'rewind;mplay' with Shift); otherwise it inserts a space. Verified error-free.

specs.label: In-viewport console ▸ Ctrl+<letter> chord
specs.note: An unclaimed Ctrl chord (e.g. Ctrl+B) forwards cmd._ctrl('B'). Unlike the dock command line, the ortho console does not exempt browser chords. Verified error-free.

specs.label: In-viewport console ▸ Alt+<letter> chord
specs.note: Alt+B with no printable composition forwards cmd._alt('B'); a composed printable char inserts instead. Verified error-free.

specs.label: In-viewport console ▸ Ctrl+Shift+<letter> chord
specs.note: Ctrl+Shift+B forwards cmd._ctsh('B'). Verified error-free.

specs.label: In-viewport console ▸ Left/Right cursor
specs.note: ArrowLeft/ArrowRight move the ortho cursor only while arrows are grabbed (text entered AND visible); ungrabbed they fall through to the scene/movie bindings and this component returns 'none'. Verified error-free.

specs.label: In-viewport console ▸ click dismisses splash/auto-overlay
specs.note: onMouseDown on the ortho band calls removeSplash + removeAutoOverlay (OrthoButton) and focuses it for key capture. Verified error-free.

specs.label: In-viewport console ▸ browser paste event inserts text
specs.note: The onPaste handler inserts clipboardData text (newlines to spaces) into the ortho line. The audit DSL cannot dispatch a synthetic clipboard paste, so this is recorded for completeness; handler safety only.

specs.label: Viewport ▸ rubber-band selection rectangle
specs.note: OrthoLoopRect draws a CSS box [data-testid=ortho-loop] during a viewport pointer drag whose ButMode slot is a box-select/zoom action; the selection itself is made in the C by ExecutiveSelectRect. Needs a real pointer drag on the canvas (no drag primitive in the audit DSL) and backend picking, so it is recorded BLOCKED.
